text:
The appellate court will likely reverse the felony-murder conviction. The agency rule, which many modern courts and the Model Penal Code favor, does not attribute a co-felon's death caused by police to the surviving felon. The proximate-cause rule that some jurisdictions still follow would uphold the conviction, so the outcome depends on the jurisdiction. The team note's claim that all states impose liability for any death during the crime, and its focus on who fired first, do not reflect the doctrine.

CONFIDENCE: 60
